results.title: Manila Sunset
results.overview: When a sudden family death pulls a fractured Filipino-American family back under one roof, a week of funeral preparations becomes a final chance to reunite as their Lola (grandmother) slowly forgets them all.

results.title: Rajah
results.overview: Cakra and Nilam are beset by mystical terrors ready to devour their souls. Fate brings them together with Malawangsa and Birsha, along with the emergence of Tribuana. Will they survive the unseen threat, or will it lead them to an even more terrifying age of madness?

results.title: Gill
results.overview: A boy named Gon was on the verge of death when gills grew on his body, allowing him to breathe again. Kang-ha and his grandpa rescue Gon. They grow into a peculiar family together. Kang-ha persecutes Gon who cut off from the world, but he send Gon out into the world to protect him. Like Gon's name which the same one as a fantasy bird that goes thousands of miles a day.

results.title: Daniele Gatti & Gautier Capuçon Wagner, Saint-Saëns, and Debussy
results.original_title: Daniele Gatti & Gautier Capucon Wagner, Saint-Saens et Debussy
results.overview: A concert where German and French Romanticism engage in a dialogue, revealing as many differences as they do similarities. Wagner invites the listener into a contemplative state bordering on ecstasy, while the sensuality of Saint-Saëns’s Cello Concerto and Debussy’s Impressionist evocation of nature unfold.

results.title: Sentient
results.overview: An investigation into laboratory research on animals exposes a hidden world in which it’s not just the animals getting hurt. The story of Dr. Lisa Jones Engel, a primatologist turned animal welfare advocate, asks whether harming animals and ourselves in science’s name is justified

results.title: White Haired Witch's Blood Phoenix
results.overview: Adapted from the novel series “Baifa Monü Zhuan” by Liang Yu Sheng.

results.title: Bi-Coastal
results.overview: Fledgling filmmaker Jordan flies to New York to reclaim a debt from his eccentric friend Tyler. As months pass without repayment, Jordan's Hollywood dreams become eclipsed by sexual hijinks, booze, and an exploration of gender identity.

results.title: Horror and Love
results.overview: A love letter to the world of freaks, this documentary retraces the birth of Horrorland, voted Europe's Best Scream Park, as well as the love story between Cristina Raya and David Moreno, the two main driving forces behind this Catalan theme park. From St. Louis to Vilassar de Dalt, by way of Newcastle, the camera accompanies them on their odyssey to build a dream called Horrorland.

results.title: For Those Who Love, Leave, and Love Again
results.original_title: For Those Who Love, Leave, and Love Again
results.overview: Haunted by the memory of an absent, violent father, Paul moves restlessly through Berlin’s night, drifting into fleeting encounters that only deepen his loneliness.

results.title: Coma
results.overview: After learning that her daughter had frozen her eggs, her mother decided to urgently find a father for her "grandchildren" – and no obstacles would stop her on this path.

results.title: Strong Son
results.overview: A former South Asian bodybuilder moves back in with his aging father to become his primary caregiver, forcing him to balance the physical strength that once defined him with the mental and emotional challenges of caring for the man who raised him.

results.title: Twosome
results.overview: Dining out for their anniversary, Andy and Scarlett get blanked by a woman they had a threesome with months earlier, prompting them to relitigate the encounter’s consent politics in excruciating detail.

results.title: Genesis
results.overview: A man and a woman, two travelers heading towards their final stop, meet in a cheap motel room. They drink, listen to music, have sex, and contemplate the time that passes them by.

results.title: Saturday
results.overview: A daughter returns home to be with her mother  as she prepares to make a choice that  generations before her were never allowed to  make.

results.title: Chris & Martina: The Final Set
results.overview: Tennis legends Chris Evert and Martina Navratilova reflect on their parallel journeys to sports stardom while delving into their rivalry and friendship, especially as the duo continue to support each other through their shared experience of cancer treatment.

results.title: So haben wir dich nicht erzogen
results.original_title: So haben wir dich nicht erzogen
results.overview: Balbina and Inka believe they’ve done everything right. Their daughter Hedwig has always been the model, politically correct child. Until recently. Because the two mothers don’t know that someone has entered Hedwig’s life who is turning their perfect family upside down: a man.

results.title: Catalunya-Madrid: La veritat de dos models econòmics
results.original_title: Catalunya-Madrid: La veritat de dos models econòmics

results.title: Rift
results.overview: How far would you go to ease your pain? When desperation drives a woman to test an unproven drug, she finds herself crossing the boundary between our world and something far stranger. What begins as a risky experiment leaves a door open - and some doors can't be closed.

results.title: The A List: 15 Stories from Asian and Pacific Diasporas
results.original_title: The A List: 15 Stories from Asian and Pacific Diasporas
results.overview: Sandra Oh, Sen. Tammy Duckworth, Kumail Nanjiani, Amanda Nguyen, Connie Chung, and beyond: their worlds may be disparate, but they’ve all, in their unique ways, navigated what it means to be Asian in relation to their American identities. While their success has been fraught with racism, they share their stories of losses and wins.

results.title: Photographer
results.overview: Photographer follows Veera, a troubled and obsessive photographer determined to prove his worth in a world that has long dismissed him. Driven by ambition and haunted by a painful past, he ventures deep into Mathikettan Solai, a mysterious reserve forest, to capture a rare and elusive natural phenomenon that could change his life forever.
